personality.description: This person tends to stick with familiar routines, relies on proven methods, and is slow to embrace unfamiliar ideas, but they also approach life in a spontaneous, loosely structured way that can leave details unfinished or deadlines missed. In moral dilemmas, they usually stay calm and emotionally steady, but they are likely to judge situations pragmatically and protect their own interests rather than assume others are acting in good faith. They are comfortable both speaking and listening in group discussions, yet they may sound guarded, skeptical, and somewhat competitive, often challenging others’ claims while keeping their own tone controlled and composed. Even under pressure, they remain resilient and rarely show much distress.
traits: has achieved positions of leadership through exceptional performance and abilities
focuses on fostering positive relationships and teamwork
cares a lot about what others think of them
takes input from others on how tasks should be accomplished
is quick to find common ground between other people's ideas and their own
